models.desc: New architecture (inkling2_loop): 24 layers, the middle 12 run three times (48 layer passes per token), MoE 8 of 128 experts, hybrid local (1024 window) + global attention, vision. Kernel bin-inklingm = llama.cpp master e50c254a (2026-11-21: merged Inkling-2-Mini support #32694 + #32704), with ggml-org's IQ4_NL in the merged layout: 37.4 tok/s on one A4500. Before, unsloth's UD-Q4_K_M (layout of the unmerged PR #32695, kernel bin-inkling) made 29.7 and scored 89.9; those results are kept as *-unsloth-pr32695. Runs on the A4500 alone: split over both cards it makes 5-9 tok/s (looped layers' later passes hop cards; -sm row / tensor not supported). Compute buffer grows with context x ubatch (about 3.3 GB at 32k x 512): 32k at ub 256, 64k at ub 128 (q8 KV), 128k at ub 64 (q4 KV, vision projector on the CPU). The chat template ignores enable_thinking; reasoning is set with reasoning_effort (none/minimal/low/medium/high, default 0.9 = high). Configs ending in -min set the server default to minimal; requests can still override it. Sampling: temperature 1.0 (generation_config). ts = A4500,V100.
